ISSUE_KIND: streetlight
ISSUE: Damaged streetlight with missing fixture
DETAILS: The photo shows a decorative streetlight pole in what appears to be daylight; one of the lamp fixtures is missing its cover or shade, and the other side appears to be a bare bulb.
ORGANIZATION: New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT)
DEPARTMENT: Division of Street Lighting Engineering
WHY: The NYC DOT maintains nearly 400,000 streetlights throughout the city, including those on public streets.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "NYC DOT maintains nearly 400,000 streetlights throughout New York City, and is a national leader in using sustainable street lighting."
